_comment: Golden fixture for Vivian bare build (M0, L60, no W-engine, no discs) — Ether/Corruption. All values formula-derived and independently verified.

events.formula_notes: MV@L12=22000+2000*11=44000; DEF_area=794*10000//(953*794//50+794)=498; crit_area=10000+500*5000//10000=10250. ATK=880 = L60 base 805 (base_atk 127 + growth 76728bp*59//10000 + promotion_stats[5].atk 226) + 75 flat ATK from core_stats[5] at core level 5 (ZO Characters/Vivian.json coreStats agrees). The prior 806 omitted the core flat ATK.

Corruption MV=62.5% per tick; AP_area=118*100=11800 (Vivian's DB base_anomaly_proficiency is 118 — the prior fixture had proficiency/mastery transposed); level_area=20000; no anomaly_dmg_bonus for bare Vivian; 20 procs is the theoretical max, see proc_counts
events.leifa_ref: references/DMG Formula for Anomaly, Disorder and Vortex Leifa.html — Corruption 62.5% base mult per tick

corruption.formula_notes: 7-hit rotation with 1.0s fallback duration; hits land at t=1.0..7.0. Corruption triggers at t=5.0 and the 10s window [5.0, 15.0] then contains hits at t=5.0, 6.0 and 7.0 — the rotation ends at t=7.0, so 3 on-hit ticks (3 x 62 = 186). Corruption is on-hit gated with a 0.5s internal CD, and these hits are 1.0s apart, so every remaining hit ticks. 20 procs is the theoretical max (Leifa) but requires >=20 hits inside the 10s window; this rotation validates per-hit gating, not max-proc count.
